entities.summary: Ezz El-Dine Ahmed Mourad Zulficar was an Egyptian film director, screenwriter, actor and producer known for his distinctive style, which blends romance and action. He is widely regarded one of the most influential filmmakers in the golden age of Egyptian Cinema. In a career spanning sixteen years, he directed over 30 feature films, many of which are still widely watched and studied today.
